name: Thomson
summary: North-central lifestyle band — café stretches, reservoir weekends, and condo clusters with improving TEL access distinct from Upper Thomson alone.
body: Thomson is the shortlist when green weekends and brunch-strip living matter more than CBD doorstep density. Condo clusters along the Thomson corridor trade some commute friction for MacRitchie / Peirce access and a less transient feel than River Valley. Expats shortlist it for family layouts and outdoor rhythm. Watch-outs: brunch queues, heat on trail days, and estate-specific visitor QR / boom-gate apps. Compare with Upper Thomson for the named TEL stop pocket, Balestier for food-spine energy, and Braddell when NSL interchange beats reservoir proximity.
bestFor: renters testing ActiveSG swim programmes nearby
watchOuts: Heat and haze on trail days
Visitor QR / intercom culture varies by condo
housingMix: Newer and mid-age condos; landed pockets toward the north.
commuteNotes: Thomson-East Coast Line gravity (Upper Thomson / Bright Hill / Caldecott depending on block). Test a Saturday trail + weekday commute before you LOI.
